items.statement: Members of Congress should face term limits.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: limiting the number of terms that members of Congress can serve
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. ATP Waves 129/130; report released Sep 2023; exact field dates not shown on page.

items.statement: Supreme Court justices should have a maximum age limit.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: a maximum age limit for Supreme Court justices
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Released Sep 2023.

items.statement: The presidential candidate who gets the most votes nationwide should win.
items.original_wording: Change the system so the candidate who receives the most votes nationwide wins the presidency vs. keep current Electoral College system
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Released Sep 2023. A 2024 Pew reading (D 80, R 46) is cited in Pew's Jul 2026 short read.

items.statement: Voters should have to show government-issued ID.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: requiring voters to show government-issued identification
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Released Sep 2023.

items.statement: All eligible citizens should be automatically registered to vote.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: automatically registering all eligible citizens to vote
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Released Sep 2023.

items.statement: Members of Congress should not be allowed to trade individual stocks.
items.original_wording: Should elected officials [members of Congress] be allowed to trade individual stocks? (% should not be allowed)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans as reported by YouGov (party ID). Fielded May 22-26, 2026. Article also ran an experimental 'banned' wording (D 69%; R not reported).

items.statement: The president must follow Supreme Court rulings, even ones he disagrees with.
items.original_wording: If the Supreme Court rules against the president in a case, does the president have the power to ignore that ruling, or is the president required to do as the ruling says? (% required)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans; page does not state whether leaners included. Fielded Sep 15-24, 2025.

items.statement: People with mental illnesses should be prevented from buying guns.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: preventing people with mental illnesses from purchasing guns
items.notes: Labeled 'Democrats'/'Republicans' on page (Pew normally includes leaners). Page is Jul 2024 compilation; policy items appear to come from the Jun 2023 survey but field dates for these items are not explicitly stated.

items.statement: The minimum age for buying guns should be 21.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: increasing the minimum age for buying guns to 21 years old
items.notes: Same caveat as guns-mental-illness re: field dates.

items.statement: Teachers and school officials should be allowed to carry guns in K-12 schools.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: allowing teachers and school officials to carry guns in K-12 schools
items.notes: Same caveat as guns-mental-illness re: field dates.

items.statement: People should be allowed to carry concealed guns in more places.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: allowing people to carry concealed guns in more places
items.notes: Same caveat as guns-mental-illness re: field dates.

items.statement: The U.S. should expand solar power.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose more solar power (Pew paraphrase; verbatim in linked questionnaire)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Apr 28-May 4, 2025.

items.statement: The U.S. should expand wind power.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose more wind power (Pew paraphrase; verbatim in linked questionnaire)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Apr 28-May 4, 2025.

items.statement: The U.S. should build more nuclear power plants.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose more nuclear power plants to generate electricity
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Apr 28-May 4, 2025.

items.statement: The federal government is doing too little to reduce the effects of climate change.
items.original_wording: Is the federal government doing too much, too little, or about the right amount to reduce the effects of climate change? (% too little)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Mar 16-22, 2026. 'Agree' = said 'too little'.

items.statement: Middle and high school students should be banned from using cellphones during class.
items.original_wording: Would you support or oppose a ban that prevents middle and high school students from using cellphones during class?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded May 26-Jun 1, 2026.

items.statement: Middle and high school students should be banned from using cellphones for the entire school day.
items.original_wording: Would you support or oppose a ban that prevents middle and high school students from using cellphones during the entire school day?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded May 26-Jun 1, 2026.

items.statement: Anyone under 16 should be banned from using social media.
items.original_wording: Would you support or oppose a ban that prevents anyone under the age of 16 from using social media sites?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded May 26-Jun 1, 2026.

items.statement: Social media companies should require parental consent for minors to open an account.
items.original_wording: Would you support social media companies requiring parental consent for minors to create a social media account?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded May 26-Jun 1, 2026.

items.statement: Social media sites should require people to verify their age.
items.original_wording: Would you support social media companies requiring people to verify their age before using social media sites?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded May 26-Jun 1, 2026.

items.statement: Social media companies should limit how much time minors spend on their sites.
items.original_wording: Would you support social media companies setting limits on how much time minors can spend on social media?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded May 26-Jun 1, 2026.

items.statement: The government should restrict false information online, even if it limits freedom of information.
items.original_wording: The U.S. government should take steps to restrict false information online, even if it limits freedom of information
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Feb 24-Mar 2, 2025.

items.statement: Tech companies should restrict false information online, even if it limits freedom of information.
items.original_wording: Tech companies should take steps to restrict false information online, even if it limits freedom of information
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Feb 24-Mar 2, 2025.

items.statement: I'm more concerned than excited about the growing use of AI in daily life.
items.original_wording: Does the increased use of artificial intelligence in daily life make you feel more excited than concerned, more concerned than excited, or equally both? (% more concerned)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Jun 9-15, 2025.

items.statement: I trust the U.S. government to regulate AI effectively.
items.original_wording: How much do you trust the U.S. to regulate the use of AI effectively? (% a lot or some)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Mar 24-30, 2025.

items.statement: Congress should extend the enhanced ACA health insurance tax credits.
items.original_wording: Should Congress extend the enhanced premium tax credits for ACA marketplace enrollees, or let them expire? (% extend)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans (party ID; leaners not specified). Fielded Jun 4-8, 2025. Exact wording paraphrased by KFF. R support fell to 50% in KFF's Oct-Nov 2025 poll (no D figure given there).

items.statement: The federal government is responsible for making sure all Americans have health coverage.
items.original_wording: Is it the federal government's responsibility to make sure all Americans have health care coverage?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Nov 17-30, 2025.

items.statement: There should be more government regulation of prescription drug prices.
items.original_wording: Is there more, less, or about the right amount of government regulation of prescription drug prices? (% not as much as there should be)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans; leaners not specified. Fielded Feb 24-Mar 2, 2026. Exact wording not shown on page.

items.statement: Social Security benefits should not be reduced in any way.
items.original_wording: Social Security benefits should not be reduced in any way (vs. reductions need to be considered)
items.notes: Labeled Democrats/Republicans on page. Report published Jun 2024; field dates not stated on page.

items.statement: Tax rates on large businesses and corporations should be raised.
items.original_wording: Should tax rates on large businesses and corporations be raised, lowered, or kept the same? (% raised)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Jan 27-Feb 2, 2025.

items.statement: Tax rates on household income over $400,000 should be raised.
items.original_wording: Should tax rates on household income over $400,000 be raised, lowered, or kept the same? (% raised)
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Jan 27-Feb 2, 2025.

items.statement: The federal government is responsible for providing adequate retirement income for all.
items.original_wording: Does the federal government have a responsibility to provide adequate income in retirement for all Americans?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Apr 7-13, 2025.

items.statement: The federal government is responsible for providing high-speed internet to all.
items.original_wording: Does the federal government have a responsibility to provide high-speed internet access for all Americans?
items.notes: Dems and Dem-leaning independents vs. Reps and Rep-leaning independents. Fielded Apr 7-13, 2025.

items.statement: The U.S. should maintain or increase its commitment to NATO.
items.original_wording: Should the U.S. increase, maintain, decrease, or withdraw its commitment to NATO? (% increase or maintain)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans (Council-Ipsos). Fielded Jun 5-8, 2026.

items.statement: The U.S. should impose additional economic and diplomatic sanctions on Russia.
items.original_wording: Support/oppose: additional economic and diplomatic sanctions on Russia
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans (Council-Ipsos). Fielded Feb 6-8, 2026. Verbatim wording not shown on page.

items.statement: The U.S. should provide military aid to Ukraine.
items.original_wording: Support/oppose: providing military aid to Ukraine
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans (Council-Ipsos). Fielded Feb 6-8, 2026. Verbatim wording not shown on page.

items.statement: Immigration is a good thing for this country today.
items.original_wording: Is immigration a good thing or a bad thing for this country today? (Gallup paraphrase on page)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans; page does not state whether leaners included. Fielded Jun 1-15, 2026.

items.statement: Immigrants living in the U.S. illegally should be deported to their home countries.
items.original_wording: Do you favor or oppose deporting immigrants who are living in the United States illegally back to their home countries?
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans; leaners not specified. Fielded Jan 27-Feb 5, 2025.

items.statement: Illegal immigrants who've lived here for years, have jobs and no criminal record should be deported.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose deporting immigrants living in the U.S. illegally back to their home countries if they have lived here for many years, have a job and no criminal record
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans; leaners not specified. Fielded Jan 27-Feb 5, 2025. Full wording truncated on fetched page; conditions paraphrased from article.

items.statement: Tax-funded vouchers should help pay for children's private school tuition.
items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: tax-funded vouchers that help pay for a child's tuition at a private school
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans; leaners not specified. Fielded Jun 5-9, 2025.

items.original_wording: Favor/oppose: requiring public schools to provide parents with lists of books
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans. Fielded Jun 5-9, 2025. Full wording not shown on page.

items.original_wording: How important is freedom of speech? (% extremely/very important)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans. Fielded Jun 5-9, 2025. Exact question stem not shown on page.

items.statement: Freedom of the press is extremely or very important.
items.original_wording: How important is freedom of the press? (% extremely/very important)
items.notes: Democrats vs Republicans. Fielded Jun 5-9, 2025. Exact question stem not shown on page.
